_doc: MVP M6 spend caps (docs/MVP-CUTLINE.md §4, docs/AI-COST-AUDIT.md). Read by packages/hermes/src/spendCaps.ts before EVERY model call in a Cockpit job, and shown by the Cockpit Costs page. perBuildUsd = total priced spend (metered + estimated) of one build run, across every retry and reopen (they keep the run id). weeklyUsd = total priced spend of the last 7 days. null = that cap is OFF. Money is Nick's decision (D5): the amounts below were approved by Nick (via Huraira) on 2026-10-13; change them only on his say-so and bump version. A run over a cap is refused with SpendCapExceededError, never retried silently. Env WFACT_CAP_PER_BUILD_USD / WFACT_CAP_WEEKLY_USD override for one run (used by the seeded over-cap test).
status: on: $5 per build, $20 per rolling 7 days, approved by Nick via Huraira 2026-10-13
